name: verified
note: The block as signed.

name: verified_after_transport
note: Quoted with '> ', one line re-wrapped: canonical text unchanged.

name: invalid_signature
note: One word of the instruction changed after signing.

name: metadata_mismatch
note: A clear metadata line edited; the signed header is intact.

name: not_yet_valid
note: Issued more than 60 s after `now`.

name: audience_mismatch
note: Block audience acme/ci-agent presented to acme/dev-agent.

name: unknown_signer
note: Signer not in the registry.

name: unknown_key
note: Signer is enrolled, this kid is not.

name: unknown_key_wrong_signer
note: An enrolled kid used with a different iss.

name: dev_key_in_enforced_mode
note: Same block, verifier in enforced mode.

name: malformed_not_detached
note: A payload segment is present; a block must be a detached JWS.

name: malformed_unknown_canon
note: Header names a canonicalization rule the verifier does not know.

name: revoked
note: The key is marked revoked in the registry.

name: webauthn_verified
note: Signed by a passkey: UV set, origin and RP ID enrolled, AAGUID allowlisted.

name: webauthn_verified_dev_mode
note: The same block in dev mode: both paths verify there.

name: webauthn_invalid_signature
note: One word changed after signing: the recomputed challenge no longer matches clientDataJSON.

name: webauthn_uv_not_performed
note: The assertion's UV flag is clear.

name: webauthn_origin_not_allowed
note: clientDataJSON.origin is not among the origins enrolled for the key.

name: webauthn_rp_id_mismatch
note: rpIdHash is not SHA-256 of the enrolled RP ID.

name: webauthn_unknown_key_wrong_credential
note: credentialId is not the credential enrolled under this kid.

name: webauthn_authenticator_not_allowed
note: The same block against a registry whose allowlist lacks the authenticator's AAGUID.

name: dev_block_with_passkey_enrolled
note: A dev block once a passkey is enrolled: the default mode is enforced and dev keys confer nothing.
